title: Just Optimised
description: Speeds up the game performance by a lot for both client and server
body:
# Just Optimised

If you want a modpack that speeds up game performance for both the client and server, this is for you.

## Features

- Higher FPS using modern optimization mods
- Faster chunk generation and loading times
- Lower RAM usage
- Better performance on both singleplayer and multiplayer
- Fixes a ton of vanilla bugs
- Improved graphics settings and cleaner configuration menus
- Smarter culling to reduce unnecessary rendering
- Clean, lightweight, and regularly updated

## Performance

**Reached 619 FPS at 32 render distance** _(Specs: Intel Core i5-12400F & NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060)_:

![32 Chunks Benchmark](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b65b89c0a859a197aa773e4f9ad4a4566238c6a2.png)

**The modpack version used: 26.2-1.0.3**

_Seed: 3354544725867848366_

## Included Optimizations

The pack combines a bunch of well-known optimization mods, including:

- Sodium
- Lithium
- FerriteCore
- ModernFix
- C2ME
- ImmediatelyFast
- Entity Culling
- Better Block Entities
- More Culling
- Better Render Distance
- Very Many Players
- ServerCore

...and various other performance mods and libraries.
